item.description: The Edmonton Oilers have themselves a struggling player who needs a change of scenery, in Andrew Mangiapane. item.title: 10 Potential Trade Destinations for Vincent Trocheck
item.description: Vincent Trocheck is right near the top of most NHL trade boards as we get set to close in on the March 6 deadline.
